title: Capitals that are Not the Largest City by Country

sources.name: Global State of Metropolis 2020 – Population Data Booklet - United Nations
List of countries whose capital is not their largest city - Wiki

_: In 1912, the capital was moved from Calcutta (now Kolkata) to New Delhi. The neighbouring city of Delhi had previously served as the capital of the Mughal Empire.

New York was the capital from 1785 to 1790 and the largest city in 1790 (narrowly edging out the next capital, Philadelphia, which served as capital from 1790 to 1800). Philadelphia was the nation's second-largest city when it was the capital. Washington is the 20th-largest ci…
Karachi was the capital from 1947 to 1958.

Brasília is a planned city and has been the capital city since its inauguration in 1960. Rio de Janeiro was the capital from 1763 until 1960. Brasília is the third most populous city in Brazil and the seventh largest metropolitan area.
Ho Chi Minh City, formerly Saigon, was the capital of South Vietnam prior to reunification.
Istanbul (as Constantinople) was the capital of the Ottoman Empire from 1453 to 1922.
Dar es Salaam was the capital until 1974.
Cape Town (pop. 4.8 million) and Bloemfontein (metro pop. 747,431) serve as legislative and judicial capitals respectively.
Yangon was the capital until 2006. Naypyidaw is a planned city and not does not have contiguous urban areas or a proper metro area.

Toronto was the capital of the Province of Canada from 1849 to 1852 and 1856 to 1858. For some years before, Kingston was the de facto capital, but when it came time to form the United Province of Canada in 1841 an official capital needed to be designated. There was much contr…
Rabat is the seventh largest city in Morocco.
A planned city, Canberra has been Australia's capital city since its foundation in 1913. However, the national parliament was based in Melbourne, Victoria until 1927.
Despite having no formal designation to the national capital of the ROC by law, Taipei has been the seat of the ROC central government since 1949.
Almaty was the capital from 1927 to 1997. Astana was named Nur-Sultan from 2019 until 2022.
Cotonou is the de facto capital with seat of government. Both cities are part of the same metropolitan area.
La Paz is the de facto capital with the seat of government; it is in Bolivia's second most populous metropolitan area.
Considering Brussels metropolitan area has more inhabitants, Antwerp is the largest in city inhabitants.

Switzerland does not have a de jure capital, but Bern was designated "federal city" with the seat of the two parliament chambers in 1848, when for the first time the independent Swiss states established standing federal authorities
Auckland was the capital from 1841 to 1865.
Both cities are part of the same metropolitan area.
Valletta is part of the Central Region, a conurbation with a population of 111,994.
Belize City was the capital until 1970
Vaduz is the second largest city in Liechtenstein. Both cities are part of the same metropolitan area.
